goldens.input: How long are messages kept on the free plan?
goldens.reference_answer: Free workspaces keep the last 90 days of messages.

goldens.input: Can I require two-factor authentication for everyone?
goldens.reference_answer: Yes. Admins can require two-factor authentication for the whole workspace.

goldens.input: Does Product Three support voice calls?
goldens.reference_answer: The Product Three documentation does not cover voice calls, so it cannot be confirmed.
